question: Should OpenClaw reintroduce `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated compatibility contract, and is the inbound-shaped helper set sufficient?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but restoring a removed plugin-runtime API defines the upgrade and deprecation contract for third-party plugins, which automation should not decide.

options.title: Accept Object-Identical Alias
options.body: Refresh the branch and land `turn === inbound`, keeping `channel.inbound.*` canonical for new and migrated plugin code.

options.title: Broaden Legacy Scope First
options.body: Require additional legacy helper names only if maintainers confirm those names were also shipped API that old plugins still call.

options.title: Reject Core Alias
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers decide old plugins must republish instead of restoring a core runtime alias.

recommendation.title: Accept Object-Identical Alias
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and land `turn === inbound`, keeping `channel.inbound.*` canonical for new and migrated plugin code.

likelyOwner.reason: The same history trail shows `steipete` authored the removal of the legacy turn surface, so he is the strongest available owner for the compatibility reversal decision.
